definition.def: Combat is fighting that takes place in a war.
examples: Over 16 million men had died in combat.
Yesterday saw hand-to-hand combat in the city.

definition.def: A combat is a battle, or a fight between two people.
examples: It was the end of a long combat.

definition.def: If people in authority combat something, they try to stop it happening.
examples: Congress has criticised new government measures to combat crime. [VERB noun]

examples.sentence: Compensation for chief executives has become a combat zone where pitched battles between investors, management and board members are fought, often behind closed doors but increasingly frequently in the full glare of press attention.
New research is now unravelling the ways in which bacteria aid digestion, regulate our immune systems, eliminate toxins, produce vitamins, affect our behaviour and even combat obesity.
In 67 BCE, a new law granted Pompey vast funds to combat the Mediterranean menace.
The topics discussed included the co-ordinated study of the destruction of forests, as well as how to combat forest fires and the extension of European research programs on the forest ecosystem.
Although initially conferred upon members of the armed forces solely on the basis of their performance in combat, the award now recognises all contributions to national life.
